title: Wolt Ads for Merchants | Pay Only Per Order - Wolt (Luxembourg)

facts.fact: Wolt states that launching an ad takes just 5 clicks to go live.
facts.quote:
Launch ads in minutes

 Just **5 clicks** to go live.

facts.fact: Wolt states that, on average, 60% of customers click on the top venues.
facts.quote: **60%** click on the top venues, on average

facts.fact: Wolt states that advertisers earn 6x the amount invested, on average.
facts.quote: Earn **6x** the amount invested, on average

facts.fact: Wolt's Sponsored Listings are billed only for completed orders, not clicks.
facts.quote: Only pay for completed orders, not clicks.

facts.fact: Wolt says Sponsored Listings place a venue in top spots across the Wolt app, including the discovery page and search results.
facts.quote: boost visibility where it matters most — on the discovery page, in search results, and more.

facts.fact: Wolt states that combining Sponsored Listings with Promos is fully pay-per-order.
facts.quote: It’s a powerful combo — fully pay-per-order.

facts.fact: Wolt offers a free trial for its ads product, with the trial length not stated on the page.
A Wolt partner (Andreja Roksandić, Head of Marketing) reports that over 30% of orders during a Wolt Ads campaign came from first-time users, paid only when they ordered.
facts.quote: over 30% of orders came from first-time users — and we only paid when they ordered.

facts.fact: Wolt's later section says launching a sponsored listing ad campaign takes 6 clicks, which conflicts with the earlier 5-click claim on the same page.
facts.quote: Launch your ad in 6 clicks — track results anytime, day or night

facts.fact: Wolt's data collaboration solutions can target new, existing or lapsed customers.
facts.quote: Precisely target the new, existing or lapsed customers with our data collaboration solutions.

facts.fact: Wolt states its off-app media reaches customers across Meta, TikTok, Google and its Electric Vehicles.
facts.quote: like across Meta, TikTok, Google and our Electric Vehicles.

facts.fact: Wolt Promos are ready-made promotions designed to give customers a reason to choose the venue.
facts.quote: Our ready-made promotions help you stand out and give customers a reason to hit “Buy”.
